citazioni: The peak temperature of differential thermogravimetry (DTG) was at 116.9 °C, where the mass-less rate is maximum in TG. This temperature (116.9 °C) is close to the temperature of the maximum mass spectrum signal intensity (115.4 °C).

Therefore, the main ingredient of evolved gas from crystal form C was DMSO, and the mass-loss stage in the temperature range of 90–130 °C in the TG curve of crystal form C was caused by the evolution process of DMSO in crystal form C.

Approximately 5–8 mg of the powder of crystal form C of DE was used for the TG–MS measurements. The sample was weighed in an alumina crucible and heated up to 300 °C with a controlled temperature program. The measurement was performed at a heating rate of 5 °C min–1 under high purity analytical grade dry helium (He) gas (99.999%) with a flow rate of 200 mL min–1.

Through TG–MS and DSC analyses, the relatively low desolvation temperature and the disappearance of original melting point of DE caused by transformation to amorphous after desolvation behavior were confirmed.

The thermodynamic property of this new solvatomorph of DE is distinct from those of most pharmaceutical solvates, and the solid state of this solvatomorph will transform into an amorphous one after the desolvation behavior.

SXRD analysis indicated that classical hydrogen bonds between DE molecules and DMSO molecules in crystal form C were absent, and only weak hydrogen bonds via C9–H9···O1D existed between them. These weak hydrogen bonds have relatively long H···A distances (2.39), D···A distances (3.281 Å), and small D–H···A angles (151°). This intermolecular interaction is weaker than other classical hydrogen bonds. This phenomenon may explain the lower temperature of desolvation of this solvatomorph of DE compared with most other solvatomorphs with DMSO.
eventi.note: TG-MS con interfaccia a skimmer: stadio di perdita di massa fra 90 e 130 °C dovuto all'evoluzione di DMSO (gas principale; frammenti m/z 32, 45, 63, 78); picco DTG a 116.9 °C, massimo del segnale MS a 115.4 °C. Il frammento H2O+ (m/z 18) non viene dal DMSO e sarebbe dovuto a «secondary reactions during desolvation». Percentuale di massa persa non scritta nel testo. a = amorfo: il TG-MS non caratterizza il solido; gli autori identificano il prodotto con DSC e PXRD (evento E2) e nelle conclusioni scrivono che la forma C «will transform into an amorphous one» (certezza media). Crogiolo di allumina, coperchio non detto.

eventi.note: Picco endotermico netto e unico a circa 120 °C, attribuito alla desolvatazione (T e' nell'intervallo 90-130 °C del TG-MS). preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: approximately 200 mg of DE raw material in 10 mL of ethanol
preparazioni.pretrattamento: soluzione agitata per una notte a temperatura ambiente e filtrata fino a soluzione limpida
citazioni: (Crystal form A) Approximately, 200 mg of DE raw material was added to 10 mL of ethanol. The solutions were stirred overnight at an ambient temperature and filtered to obtain clear and transparent solutions. The solutions were placed in a refrigerator for crystallization for approximately 10 days at 10 °C to obtain single crystals without solvents.
The prism crystals of crystal forms A and C suitable for crystal structure determined by the SXRD experiment were obtained from their solutions by slow evaporation.
preparazioni.note: Metodo registrato come evaporazione (Risultati e discussione: «slow evaporation», «solvent evaporation method»); la parte sperimentale dice solo che le soluzioni stanno in frigorifero a 10 °C per circa 10 giorni. I monocristalli sono poi macinati e setacciati (100 mesh) per le analisi.

preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: come per la forma A (circa 200 mg di DE in 10 mL), con DMSO al posto dell'etanolo
citazioni: (Crystal form C) For this solvatomorph of DE, the process basically follows the procedure for crystal form A, but the solvent in the first step was replaced by DMSO, and the solutions were placed for crystallization for approximately 30 days at 20 °C to obtain single crystals of solvatomorphs.
The prism crystals of crystal forms A and C suitable for crystal structure determined by the SXRD experiment were obtained from their solutions by slow evaporation.
preparazioni.note: Come la forma A ma con DMSO come solvente della prima fase.
